name: ShimmerText
description: Text with a soft highlight band sweeping across it on a loop, built with a pure CSS background-clip gradient animation and configurable base and shimmer colors.
a11yNotes: Renders plain inline text, so screen readers read it normally; the gradient is purely visual. Under prefers-reduced-motion the sweep animation is removed and the text renders in the solid base color.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of one sweep in seconds.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
